analyst.summary: Tata Elxsi is a high-quality, debt-free design and engineering-services company with deep exposure to automotive and media clients, but revenue growth has decelerated sharply to mid-single digits as global automotive OEMs pull back R&D spending on connected/autonomous-vehicle software. The stock has fallen roughly 40-48% over one and two years reflecting this growth scare, though it is not yet statistically cheap given the slower growth. We rate this a Hold.
